text: {"lessons":["My account rose overall, but the ups and downs show that short-term results are uncertain and past moves do not predict what comes next.","Selling some Stock D after a large gain reduced my exposure and realized proceeds, but the gain alone does not tell me whether to sell more or buy it back.","Since I trade rarely and losses weigh heavily on me, I should set a sensible allocation and review it deliberately rather than react to each month's return."]}
